scores.notes: Peter grips the seated lame man's hand in the temple court before the gilded gate, John beside him and worshippers and soldiers at the sides; both apostles oddly carry fishing nets, but nothing contradicts the moment and the gate reliefs carry no glyphs.

Holmes holds a pipe in one hand and a lens in the other, yet his cane stands unsupported against his coat (lower centre); his gaunt, slick-haired face reads as a Peter Cushing likeness. The pawnbroker board is blank; white watercolour edges top-left are accepted.
Moses raises an arm before the departing people, donkeys and families, with a radiant cloud on the mountain top; watercolour fades to white paper at the top corners and lower edges (accepted).

Kneeling priest, bronze altar, ash and tabernacle are right, but what he lowers onto the ash is a whole, live-looking white dove with wings spread (lower centre) rather than its crop and feathers, so the casting-away action is not shown.
The slip Holmes holds reads 'MISSING' in clear capitals with a portrait, and papers on the desk carry scribbled text; Holmes's gaunt slick-haired face reads as a Peter Cushing likeness.

Jesus calls with raised arm while bound Lazarus steps from the lamplit tomb doorway at right, Martha and mourners behind, stone at left; Jesus looks up and away rather than toward the tomb, a weak but not contradictory staging.
Goliath topples sideways and backward onto one hand, face up, still gripping his spear, rather than falling on his face, and he is drawn no larger than David; no stone strike is visible.
Turbaned priest kneels beside the horned bronze altar casting the dove's feathers and crop onto the ash, with Moses and people before the tabernacle; watercolour edges fade to white (accepted).
Rephaiah in a cloak points at the wall while labourers carry stone and baskets amid dust along a rebuilt wall; the two men's hand-barrow has oddly crossing poles (centre right) but reads as a tool.
The newspaper on the desk reads 'The Standard' and the bill fragment Holmes holds has pseudo-text; Holmes's gaunt slick-haired face reads as a Peter Cushing likeness.
Moses lifts an arm at the front of families, children and laden donkeys moving out below the mountain with cloud at its summit; no lettering or malformed figures found.

Alice holds the flamingo but also a wooden croquet mallet, and wire hoops stand in the lawn beside the card-soldier arches, contradicting the live-flamingo mallets; card soldiers show corner indices ('A') and a pseudo-word on a far card at right.
Mantel clock dial at right shows numerals; Holmes by the window with brougham outside and Watson half-rising fit the scene, but Holmes's gaunt slick-haired face reads as a Peter Cushing likeness.

Holmes in profile holding the sparkling blue stone has a recognisable Benedict Cumberbatch likeness (curly dark hair, long face); mantel clock shows numerals and the mantel panel has squiggled marks; white watercolour edges left and right (accepted).
Golden light pours through the city gate across the square as townsfolk raise their arms, with jars, chests and stalls; Wisdom appears only as light, no figure within the rays, and no lettering.
The station-master's paper (right) carries rows of pseudo-text like a timetable; otherwise the burning whitewashed house, fire engines, bandaged Hatherley, Holmes and Watson match the scene.

Alice is perched on top of the tea table among the cups, legs dangling over its front edge, rather than seated at it; Hatter, March Hare and dozing Dormouse with teapot are otherwise right, no lettering seen.
Tabernacle at centre under a large resting cloud, tents radiating out, families by cooking fires and resting camels and donkeys; the woven curtain figures are decoration, not glyphs.
Peter strides leftward away from both the boat and Jesus, carrying a net and staff, so he is neither stepping from the boat nor going to Jesus, who stands behind him with a lantern.
The Levite stands over the woman's still, cloaked body with knife poised, lamp at left and donkey in the doorway; the moment is grim but shows no cut or gore.

Holmes peering through a lens at the battered hat is a recognisable Benedict Cumberbatch likeness; the mantel clock (top right) shows numerals; white watercolour edges (accepted). The card on the desk is blank.
Ezekiel stands among skulls and scattered bones in a barren valley, arm raised, holding a blank tablet, with low haze; no lettering or malformed anatomy found.
The White Rabbit's scroll and the papers scattered on the floor carry pseudo-text lines; courtroom, King, Queen, tarts, jury and Alice otherwise match, though Alice is drawn at normal size.

Holmes tossing the newspaper bundle has a gaunt, receding slick-haired profile that reads as a Peter Cushing likeness; the airborne bundle shows newsprint text marks; white watercolour edges (accepted).
Daniel stands calm among closed-mouthed lions with a luminous winged angel beside him and Darius holding a torch at the wooden gate above; no lettering seen.
Rephaiah points along the wall as labourers lever a block into place and carry baskets, with armoured overseers at right; watercolour edges fade to white (accepted).
